name: Monitoring tools

subjectOf.text: Exchange based monitoring tools are not shown to counter sophisticated threats such as adversarial AI agents exploiting wallet vulnerabilities, and their feasibility for smaller exchanges is unevaluated, which limits their broader applicability.
subjectOf.abstract: It does not address how these tools counter sophisticated threats, like adversarial AI agents exploiting wallet vulnerabilities, nor evaluate their feasibility for smaller exchanges, limiting broader applicability.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185

subjectOf.text: The absence of interoperability considerations with non standardized networks restricts the utility of exchange based monitoring in a fragmented and continuously evolving DeFi landscape.
